title: Genesis 1:1 in Hebrew and written backwards
summary: Genesis 1:1 in Hebrew with each word colour-coded, its transliteration above and a row of coloured left-pointing arrows below (one per letter). Underneath, under the heading "Writing Genesis 1:1 backwards…", the same letters appear in reverse order with the same colours and right-pointing arrows.

text.text: ha'aretz v'et hashamayim et elohim bara bereshit
בראשית ברא אלהים את השמים ואת הארץ׃

uncertain: The backwards Hebrew row is the verse's letters in reverse order; it is typed here in reading order (right to left) as ץראה תאו םימשה תא םיהלא ארב תישארב — the glyphs on the slide run left to right in the original order, with arrows pointing right.
